summary: Connect waste flows, recovery options and service KPIs in a practical five-day course. Explore the outline and assess its fit for your team.
lede: Waste management and recycling training helps waste operations, environmental and municipal service professionals assess how materials move from collection through recovery and disposal. Participants map service chains, reconcile weighbridge and contractor records, check material balances, assess recycling and organics options, and draft an improvement plan with service KPIs.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits professionals who coordinate, assess or plan solid waste services and need to connect collection, recovery and disposal decisions. It is designed for practitioners with working exposure to waste operations, environmental services or resource recovery.
modules: Mass Balance and Material Flow Analysis
Integrated ISWM Plan and KPI Dashboard
prerequisites: Working knowledge of solid waste collection, environmental services or resource recovery is expected. No coding or programming is required.
